All five functions implemented in `problems.py` and verified with throwaway checks covering every docstring example plus edge cases:

- `parse_duration` — regex-validated tokenizer enforcing unit order, no duplicates, no stray chars/whitespace/negatives.
- `luhn_valid` — strips spaces/hyphens, returns `False` on empty or non-digit input, never raises.
- `flatten` — recursive flattening, empty nested dicts dropped, input untouched.
- `top_k_frequent` — sorted by `(-count, word)`, handles `k <= 0` and oversized `k`.
- `rolling_max` — O(n) monotonic deque; `ValueError` for `window <= 0`, `[]` when window exceeds length.

All checks pass.
